# Design Comparison: Project Alpha vs. Project Beta

## Source notes

> # 저수지 Alpha
> Alpha 프로젝트의 저장 용량은 37리터입니다. Alpha는 SQLite를 사용하며 일요일에는 쓰기를 중지합니다. 백업은 하루에 한 번 실행됩니다. [E1]

> Project Beta stores 92 litres. Beta uses append-only log files. Beta permits writes on Sundays. Backups run twice a day. [E2, E3]

## Sunday Write Implementation and Frequency

Project Alpha implements a policy of stopping writes on Sundays. [E4]

Project Beta permits writes on Sundays. [E5]

## Source notes

Project Alpha performs backups once per day. [E6]

Project Beta runs backups twice a day. [E7]
